lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, forming a series of vertical alignments with larger spot diameters concentrated in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical alignments of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal zones of similar intensity, creating a grid where circular spots occupy the intersection nodes posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear feature with a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (bright superior, dark inferior) originates posterior to the gill slits and extends horizontally across the upper mid-flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance ichthyofaunal silhouettes swimming synchronously below the primary subject.
